newsitem.title: USA: Media 100 sees Q3 revs not rising over Q2.
newsitem.headline: Media 100 sees Q3 revs not rising over Q2.

text.p: Media 100 Inc, a digital video systems company, said Thursday it was cautious about its outlook for the third quarter, and currently expect that revenues will not increase over second quarter levels.
John Molinari, chief executive officer, said in a statement that international sales are expected to be adversely impacted during the July and August vacation period.
The company will not begin commercial shipments until late in the third quarter of its new Media 100 xs with HDRfx Option product, he added.

The company said that for the second quarter ended May 31, 1997 income from continuing operations was $336,000, or $0.04 per share on net sales of $12.1 million. That compared with operating income of $1.2 million or $0.14 a share on net sales of $12.9 million during the second quarter of 1996, it said.
Molinari noted that the company's financial position remains strong, with over $30 million in cash on the balance sheet at the end of the quarter.
